column1: # Game profile of Bayonetta 3 (Switch, update v131072 = 1.2.0; English, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese). Plays on the
# iPhone; on the Mac from the boot through the title, a new game (difficulty, Naive Angel Mode, brightness), the opening movie and the prologue's first scene and play, at 60 fps in play (30 on the
# title and the loading screens, as the game asks)
# PlatinumGames' own engine on NVN, SDK 13.3.2 (no other game's sdk build). Modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie: the WebM movies) + sdk; Wwise sound.
# RomFS: 72 PKZ archives (14 GB; 'pkzl', entries compressed one by one, Oodle Kraken or stored) holding PlatinumGames DAT archives, beside loose WebM movies (movie/, 478 files).
# The shaders are the engine's own shader objects (VSO / PSO / CSO / HSO / DSO: a control section and a code area each), all 8,024 in root_000.pkz: shader*.dat and
# autoshadereff.dat (shader_split.py pkz_entries, pg_shader); the split decodes the Kraken entries with the game's own Oodle in the Mac host's tool mode, whose streaming decoder
# hle_oodle.c finds when main has no OodleLZ_Decompress (this one reads its archives only through OodleLZDecoder_*)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# full: the camera is on the right stick, and the D-pad picks items
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): nninitStartup sets a heap of the pool − used memory (3.09 GB here), which the game maps only as it touches it. The 4 GB block
# of the other games without virtual address memory (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region)
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (the game's SetHeapSize asks for pool − used)
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; the shader objects in root_000.pkz) ----
